records.context: Owner supplied screenshot from the published Windows installer on a system where installation could not proceed.
records.claimDecision: Fresh-install failure is caused by the not-yet-created application directory being used as Inno Setup Exec WorkingDir before Prepare-Upgrade.ps1 can run.
Fresh install and upgrade are separate lifecycle paths: fresh install has no previous runtime to inspect; upgrade retains safety verification.
records.rejectedAlternative: Remove Prepare-Upgrade safety verification entirely; rejected because it weakens real upgrade rollback protection.

records.claimDecision: V43 uses Setup temporary directory as upgrade-helper WorkingDir and passes AppRoot explicitly.
Public Windows asset keeps R43 in filename although user-facing release is 4.3.0 because installed R41 ranks Windows update assets by R-number.
Current exact V43 installer build authority before hosted promotion.
Hosted fresh-install validation closed the original installer failure on both PR and post-merge main.
records.evidenceSource: CI #167 and CI #168 windows-installer-fresh both PASS; each built V43 then installed into an absent app directory.

records.claimDecision: The exact public Windows asset upgraded an installed 4.2 R40 system to 4.3 successfully without changing the default route.
records.evidenceSource: Live install exit 0; installed version 4.3.0 / revision 4.3.0-r43-final; Ethernet 3 -> 192.168.20.1 unchanged.

records.claimDecision: Post-publish updater semantics are closed for both Windows and Linux.
records.evidenceSource: Windows 43=43 no-update with exact GitHub digest; Linux 14=14 no-update from latest v4.3.0 with unchanged R14 digest and unchanged route.

records.claimDecision: GitHub Releases was simplified to one public release, v4.3.0, while Git tags/history were preserved.
records.evidenceSource: 16 superseded release objects deleted after archiving pre-cleanup release inventory SHA-256 B32D30624F1E9776F6309F295F815CD798875DABBA9E5C3608783FB791CE66EB; v4.3.0 remains latest.

openGates: Trusted Windows Authenticode identity remains external/missing; public installer is NotSigned.
exactNextAction: No product action. Preserve v4.3.0 as the single public release. Create a successor only for a new evidence-backed bug/requirement or an externally provisioned trusted Windows signing identity.
